    Derive the structural integer arguments of a FREM model

    fremModelInfo.Rd

    Works out numNonFREMThetas, numSkipOm, numParCov, numFREMThetas and numSigmas from a FREM model file and its .ext (or a getSamples() result), so the user does not have to supply them by hand to the FREM analysis functions.

    Usage

    fremModelInfo(modFile, dfext, numNonFREMThetas = NULL, numSkipOm = NULL)

    Arguments

    modFile

    Path to the FREM model file. Must contain the PsN-style ;;;FREM CODE BEGIN COMPACT / ;;;FREM CODE END COMPACT markers (models from createFREMmodel(), updateFREMmodel() and createMinimalFremModel() all carry them) and a final $OMEGA BLOCK(N) record.

    dfext

    A data frame with THETA* / OMEGA* / SIGMA* columns - a getExt() result or a PMXForest::getSamples() result - or a path to a NONMEM .ext file.

    numNonFREMThetas, numSkipOm

    Optional. If supplied they are returned as given (an override), but a value that disagrees with the one derived from the model triggers a warning. Leave NULL (default) to use the derived value.

    Value

    A list with components numNonFREMThetas, numFREMThetas, numParCov, numSkipOm, numSigmas, numTotEta, numTotThetas, covNames, orgCovNames and polyCatCovs.

    Details

    The derivation is:

    
numFREMThetas    = length(getCovNames(modFile)$covNames)
numTotThetas     = number of THETA columns in `dfext`
numNonFREMThetas = numTotThetas - numFREMThetas
numTotEta        = solve k(k+1)/2 = number of OMEGA columns in `dfext`
blockN           = N in the final "$OMEGA BLOCK(N)" record of `modFile`
numParCov        = blockN - numFREMThetas
numSkipOm        = numTotEta - blockN
numSigmas        = number of SIGMA columns in `dfext`

    numSkipOm is taken as numTotEta - blockN rather than by counting the simple $OMEGA records before the block; that is robust to a structural correlation $OMEGA BLOCK(k) sitting before the FREM block.

    See also

    Other NONMEM Parsers: getCovNames(), getExt(), getFileNames(), getPhi()

    Examples

    modFile <- system.file("extdata/SimNeb/run31.mod", package = "PMXFrem")
extFile <- system.file("extdata/SimNeb/run31.ext", package = "PMXFrem")
fremModelInfo(modFile, extFile)
#> $numNonFREMThetas
#> [1] 7
#> 
#> $numFREMThetas
#> [1] 18
#> 
#> $numParCov
#> [1] 3
#> 
#> $numSkipOm
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $numSigmas
#> [1] 3
#> 
#> $numTotEta
#> [1] 23
#> 
#> $numTotThetas
#> [1] 25
#> 
#> $covNames
#>  [1] "WT"      "HT"      "LBWT"    "BSA"     "AGE"     "AST"     "ALT"    
#>  [8] "BILI"    "CRCL"    "BMI"     "SEX"     "RACEL_3" "RACEL_2" "NCIL_2" 
#> [15] "NCIL_1"  "GENO2"   "ETHNIC"  "SMOK"   
#> 
#> $orgCovNames
#>  [1] "AGE"    "ALT"    "AST"    "BILI"   "BMI"    "BSA"    "CRCL"   "ETHNIC"
#>  [9] "GENO2"  "HT"     "LBWT"   "NCIL"   "RACEL"  "SEX"    "SMOK"   "WT"    
#> 
#> $polyCatCovs
#> [1] "RACEL_3" "RACEL_2" "NCIL_2"  "NCIL_1" 
#>
